theme: CS5-4 tuple patterns on late-resolved subjects checked by kind
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a tuple pattern whose subject is still a type var at bind time (a generic fn's return, arr_find's payload) is recorded, and solve() checks each Ident component by kind against its element once the subject resolves to a tuple of the pattern's arity; nothing is bound or unified and another arity is skipped. So (a, b) on id((1, "s")) with b + 1 is E0102 instead of a run panic. New refusal of a program that runs: println(a) of an int component of such a subject (u12; NH-1 (a)). No interpreter or runtime change. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes and diagnostics as the base binary.
